GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-12-06T16:28:30Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: OnAfterRenderAsync still called twice on 3.0.0-preview9.19465.2
Description: ### Describe the bug
Using server-side prerendering, if you have the following `OnAfterRenderAsync`:

```
protected override async Task OnAfterRenderAsync(bool firstRender)
{
	if (firstRender)
	{
		await MyTask();
		Console.WriteLine("FirstRender");
	}

	Console.WriteLine("OnAfterRenderAsync");
}
```

Then "OnAfterRenderAsync" is still written to the console _twice_ even though previously it was stated that starting in preview 9 `OnAfterRenderAsync` would _not_ be called during the prerendering lifecycle at all.

### To Reproduce


Create a new blazor project with server-side prerendering enabled.

Create a component that overrides `OnAfterRenderAsync`

That override will be called twice during rendering.

### Further technical details
- ASP.NET Core version : 3.0.0-preview9.19465.2
- IDE: VS2019 Version 16.3.8
